dialog:67: There you are knight! Why didn't you fight us inside your temple?
dialog:68: There you are, Seiya. You showed courage and exceptional strenght to have reached me.

dialog:70: Those roses you're holding! It was you who murdered my master Albior on the island of Andromeda many years ago, right?
dialog:71: Very well, you have proven your bravery and your honor as a knight, I agree to let you pass Hyoga, go join your friends...
dialog:72: We don't have time to think For now, just focus on getting. through! Let's go!
dialog:73: We don't have time to think For now, just focus on getting. through! Let's go!

dialog:79: What are you doing? You fool!

dialog:83: What's going on? What's happening to you??

dialog:85: Who allowed you to enter my temple?
dialog:86: Without your 5 senses, your body is just a piece of meat now...

dialog:89: You are an idiot Jaki! I'll beat you like I beat your brother Cassios before!!
dialog:90: You are quite resistant; but, do you think you can resist the bloody corpion stings Hyoga?
dialog:91: You are the Gemini Knight!! It's you who usurped the place of the true great pope all this time!!
dialog:92: You are the golden knight of the virgin Shaka, the one who claims to be closest to the gods?
dialog:93: You are usurpers with your false Athena! You deserve death for speaking such blasphemies!
dialog:94: You guys are tougher than I thought! Let's continue this fight in the realm of the dead! By the waves of Hades!
dialog:95: You leave me no choice, the only way to defeat you  is to use the Forbidden Ultimate Dragon Technique!
dialog:96: You were under the influence of the great pope who controlled your mind... You came to your senses after killing someone... Cassios...
dialog:97: You will die Hyoga! No one has been able to survive multiple scorpion stings so far; receive the last one! the needle of Antares!!

dialog:99: You won't ever reach the first house!! Ahaha!!

mu:combo: Repeatedly press Attack to perform a combo. Now it's your turn!
mu:down: Press Down + Attack to perform a low kick and stun your enemy.
mu:up: Press Up + Attack to perform a high kick and launch your enemy into the air.
mu:special: Press Forward + Special to unleash your special attack. It consumes Cosmos, so use it carefully!
mu:dash: Quickly press Forward twice, then Attack to perform a dash attack!
mu:charge: Hold Attack for five seconds, then release it to unleash a charged attack.
mu:backattack: Press Back + Attack to perform a back attack. Try it!
mu:uppercut: Press Up + Special to perform a powerful uppercut and launch your enemies into the air!
mu:ultra: Press Down + Special to unleash your ultimate attack. Burn your Cosmos!
mu:jump: Press Jump, then Attack to perform an aerial attack. Now it's your turn!
mu:end: Training is complete! It is time to repair your Cloths: difficult battles await you!
mu:throw: Grab an enemy, then press Attack to strike. Finish by pressing Forward + Attack to throw them!
